css_architecture.summary: Tailwind v4 CSS-first config. No tailwind.config.js. All design tokens in @theme inside packages/ui/styles/tokens.css. All shared base styles in packages/ui/styles/base.css. Each app globals.css is minimal — only imports + @source + app-specific rules.
import_order: 2. @import '@qoovex/ui/styles/base'    — shared reset and semantic base in @layer base
4. @source '../../../../packages/ui/src' — explicit source scan for monorepo packages

source_rule.description: @source path is ALWAYS relative to the CSS file itself, not the project root, not postcss.config.mjs, not the app root.
source_rule.explanation: apps/X/src/app/globals.css → 4 levels up = monorepo root → packages/ui/src

css_architecture.theme_rule: Always use @theme {} WITHOUT the 'static' keyword. @theme static prevents CSS custom properties from being emitted to :root, breaking all var(--color-*) usage in raw CSS and inline styles.
css_architecture.layer_rule: All rules in packages/ui/styles/base.css must be wrapped in @layer base. This ensures Tailwind utility classes always win in specificity — bg-primary beats button { background: none }.

shared_files.tokens.css: packages/ui/styles/tokens.css — @theme block with all design tokens. Single source of truth. Never duplicate in apps.
shared_files.base.css: packages/ui/styles/base.css — @layer base with reset, html, body, h1-h6, scrollbar, focus-visible, prefers-reduced-motion, font @import. Single source of truth. Never duplicate in apps.
shared_files.app_globals_css: Each app's src/app/globals.css contains ONLY: 3 imports + @source + app-specific rules that genuinely differ per app.

css_architecture.transpile_rule: Every app that imports from a @qoovex/* TypeScript package must list it in transpilePackages in its next.config.ts. Currently required: transpilePackages: ['@qoovex/ui', '@qoovex/db']. Extend the array when new packages are added.
what_goes_in_app_globals: scroll-padding-top if the app has a fixed header at a specific height
app-specific CSS classes that are not part of the shared design system
nothing else — if you find yourself writing html/body rules in an app globals.css, it belongs in base.css

auth_architecture.scope: apps/workspace ONLY — Clerk must never be installed in apps/web. Adding Clerk to the marketing site adds unnecessary JS bundle, auth context and ClerkProvider overhead to a static site.

middleware.pattern: clerkMiddleware + createRouteMatcher — protect all routes except /sign-in and /sign-up via auth.protect()
middleware.matcher: exclude _next, static files; include all /api routes

auth_architecture.provider_wrapper: ClerkProvider wraps the html element in apps/workspace/src/app/layout.tsx only
auth_architecture.vercel_project: Qoovex-workspace — Clerk env vars must also be added in the Vercel project environment settings

packages_tsconfig_rules.problem: packages/* that contain React hooks or browser APIs must explicitly declare lib and jsx in their tsconfig.json. Without this TypeScript cannot resolve 'react', 'fetch', or any DOM API.
packages_tsconfig_rules.peer_deps_rule: Any package that uses React hooks must declare react as peerDependency AND devDependency. It must NOT bundle React — consumers provide it.

architecture.shared_code_rule: reusable code belongs in packages, not duplicated in apps
architecture.asset_rule: shared brand assets must live in a shared package; app public folders are only for app-specific assets

packages.ui: shared design system and reusable ui — includes styles/tokens.css (@theme), styles/base.css (@layer base reset), src/components/
packages.db: prisma schema, prisma config, database client
packages.utils: shared pure utilities — tsconfig must include lib:[dom] and jsx:react-jsx when hooks are present
packages.brand: shared brand assets such as logo, icon, marks and other common brand files
packages.ai: AI providers config, scheduling engine, chat, parsing, recipe matching, vision scan — added 2026-04-10

rules: never add hover to non-interactive elements
shared brand assets must come from the shared brand source of truth, not duplicated app public folders
if ui feels generic or template-like, redesign it

work_plan_rules: joining other users work plans is always free and unlimited
limits apply only to plan creation and member count per plan
only the plan creator can create tasks
task completion sends notification to the creator
tasks can be free text or linked to a recipe snapshot, including private recipes
when a member completes a PRODUCE task they declare the actual quantity — DB updates PrepItem.currentStock atomically
when a member completes a CONSUME task they confirm the quantity used — DB decrements PrepItem.currentStock atomically
PrepItem stock operations must use Prisma $transaction to prevent race conditions
PrepItem belongs to the workspace (creator), shared across all plans in that workspace
DRAFT plans are invisible to members — only ACTIVE plans are visible to the team
AI schedule generation is one-shot: chef triggers it manually, result can be accepted or ignored
AI chat token counter is per WorkPlan, not per month
if PrepItem.currentStock drops below PrepItem.parLevel, send push notification to workspace creator
recipe snapshot on task must not reference the live recipe — it must be a frozen copy at time of assignment

work_plan_types.PRODUCTION: batch prep session that increases PrepItem stock
work_plan_types.EVENT: ceremony or special event that consumes existing PrepItem stock
work_plan_types.SERVICE: daily service — mix of fresh prep and stock consumption

prep_stock_rules: PrepItem is a semi-finished product produced by the brigade and stored for future use
PrepItem has: name, unit, currentStock, parLevel, typicalBatch, storageType, shelfLifeDays, optional recipeId
each production is logged as PrepProduction with quantity, date, producedBy, linked workTaskId
each consumption is logged as PrepConsumption with quantity, date, consumedBy, linked workTaskId and workPlanId
stock history is derived from PrepProduction and PrepConsumption records
PAR level alert fires when currentStock < parLevel
explore_rules: public discovery of recipes and menus

ai_stack.philosophy: three distinct problems require three distinct solutions — not everything is AI

scheduling_engine.description: topological sort + Critical Path Method + greedy parallel assignment
scheduling_engine.rationale: deterministic, zero cost, zero latency, fully explainable — scheduling is a constraint satisfaction problem, not a language task

operational_ai.rationale: extremely fast, very cheap (~$0.075/1M tokens), native structured output, Vision included

used_for: AI chat co-pilot during plan building
conversational_ai.rationale: European/GDPR-friendly (French company), excellent Italian, 128k context, ~$0.10/1M tokens, conversational quality

ai_stack.provider_strategy: Vercel AI SDK with @ai-sdk/google and @ai-sdk/mistral — no OpenRouter needed, direct provider SDKs for reliability

database_memory.prisma_version_flow: Prisma 7 uses prisma.config.ts as datasource configuration source
rules: do not keep fake root .env placeholders
link the correct app directory to the correct Vercel project
database env must be real before running prisma push
Clerk env vars (NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, CLERK_SECRET_KEY) must be set in Vercel project Qoovex-workspace — never in the apps/web Vercel project

confirmed_decisions.reason: shared ui, types, config and business logic across apps

confirmed_decisions.reason: better workspace management and shared-package flow

confirmed_decisions.decision: Qoovex workspace
confirmed_decisions.reason: clear and product-focused naming

confirmed_decisions.decision: prefer Tauri over Electron
confirmed_decisions.reason: lighter desktop approach

confirmed_decisions.decision: use Prisma 7 with prisma.config.ts and DATABASE_URL
confirmed_decisions.reason: current Prisma flow

confirmed_decisions.decision: keep logo, icon and shared brand assets in one shared package source of truth, not duplicated inside apps/web/public and apps/workspace/public
confirmed_decisions.reason: avoids drift, duplicate updates and inconsistent branding across apps

confirmed_decisions.decision: dual AI model: Gemini 2.0 Flash for operational/parsing/vision + Mistral Small 3.1 for conversational chat co-pilot. Scheduling is pure TypeScript (no AI).
confirmed_decisions.reason: cost control, GDPR compliance (Mistral EU), separation of concerns, deterministic scheduling

confirmed_decisions.decision: create packages/ai with @ai-sdk/google and @ai-sdk/mistral. No OpenRouter — direct provider SDKs via Vercel AI SDK.
confirmed_decisions.reason: reliability, direct billing control, easier debugging

confirmed_decisions.decision: PrepItem is a first-class domain entity in the workspace — semi-finished products with stock tracking, PAR levels, and storage type. Available from START plan.
confirmed_decisions.reason: core kitchen workflow — chefs produce in batches and consume over time. Without stock tracking the work plan is just a todo list.

confirmed_decisions.decision: AI schedule generation is one-shot only. Chef triggers manually. Result can be accepted or manually adjusted.
confirmed_decisions.reason: real-time rescheduling would be too costly in API calls and too disruptive UX

confirmed_decisions.decision: token limit is per WorkPlan (not monthly). START: 50k, PRO: 500k, ENTERPRISE: unlimited.
confirmed_decisions.reason: predictable cost control per unit of work, not per calendar period

confirmed_decisions.decision: WorkTask has activeMinutes (requires physical presence) and passiveMinutes (waiting time: blast chilling, resting, marinating) + passiveLabel. Scheduler fills passive slots with parallel tasks.
confirmed_decisions.reason: core insight of kitchen scheduling — passive time is free time that can be filled with other tasks

confirmed_decisions.decision: when a task is linked to a recipe, the recipe is stored as a frozen JSON snapshot on the task — not a live foreign key reference. The recipeId is kept as optional metadata only.
confirmed_decisions.reason: chef may edit or delete recipes later. The task must preserve what was shown to the member at the time of assignment.

confirmed_decisions.decision: All shared CSS rules (html, body, reset, scrollbar, focus, fonts, prefers-reduced-motion) live in packages/ui/styles/base.css in @layer base. App globals.css contains only imports + @source + app-specific rules. Never duplicate base rules in apps.
confirmed_decisions.reason: DRY principle — three apps sharing identical CSS blocks is fragile and will drift. Single source of truth in packages/ui/styles/.

confirmed_decisions.decision: Always use @theme {} without the 'static' keyword in tokens.css.
confirmed_decisions.reason: @theme static generates utility classes but does NOT emit CSS custom properties to :root, breaking all var(--color-*) usage in raw CSS and inline styles.

confirmed_decisions.decision: @source path in globals.css is '../../../../packages/ui/src' — relative to the CSS file location (apps/X/src/app/globals.css), 4 levels up to monorepo root, then into packages/ui/src.
confirmed_decisions.reason: Tailwind v4 does not auto-scan workspace packages. Without @source, utility classes used in packages/ui components are never generated in the CSS output.

confirmed_decisions.decision: Clerk (@clerk/nextjs) is installed ONLY in apps/workspace. apps/web must never have @clerk/nextjs as a dependency.
confirmed_decisions.reason: Clerk adds ClerkProvider, auth context and JS bundle overhead that is completely unnecessary on a static marketing site. It slows down page load for zero benefit.

confirmed_decisions.decision: Clerk env vars live in apps/workspace/.env.local — not in the monorepo root .env, not in apps/web.
confirmed_decisions.reason: Scoping env vars to the correct app prevents accidental exposure and keeps each app's environment self-contained.

confirmed_decisions.decision: apps/workspace/src/middleware.ts uses clerkMiddleware + createRouteMatcher. Public routes: /sign-in(.*) and /sign-up(.*). All other routes call auth.protect().
confirmed_decisions.reason: standard Clerk v6 pattern — explicit allowlist of public routes is safer than a blocklist.

confirmed_decisions.decision: packages/utils tsconfig.json must include lib:[dom, dom.iterable, esnext] and jsx:react-jsx when the package contains React hooks or uses fetch/browser APIs.
confirmed_decisions.reason: Without lib:dom TypeScript does not know about fetch, Response, or any browser global. Without jsx:react-jsx React hooks cannot be compiled. Both errors appeared as real TS errors in this session.

confirmed_decisions.decision: packages/utils (and any package with hooks) must declare react as peerDependency AND devDependency. Never bundle React inside a shared package.
confirmed_decisions.reason: Without the peer dep declaration TypeScript cannot resolve 'react' and the hook file produces 'Cannot find module react' errors.

confirmed_decisions.decision: apps/workspace/next.config.ts must have transpilePackages: ['@qoovex/ui', '@qoovex/db']. When a new @qoovex/* package is imported by the app, add it to this array immediately.
confirmed_decisions.reason: Next.js cannot compile TypeScript in monorepo packages without explicit transpilePackages. Missing this entry produces 'Cannot find module @qoovex/db' at compile time.

confirmed_decisions.decision: All parameters in async callbacks (.then, .filter, .map, setState updaters) must be explicitly typed. Implicit any is a compile error under strict mode.
confirmed_decisions.reason: TypeScript strict mode treats implicit any as TS7006. Always define a local type at the top of the file and annotate every callback parameter.

rejected_choices.reason: adds an unnecessary middleware layer — direct provider SDKs via Vercel AI SDK are more reliable and easier to debug

rejected_choices.choice: single AI model for both scheduling and chat
rejected_choices.reason: wrong tool for scheduling — scheduling is a deterministic algorithm problem, not a language task

rejected_choices.choice: real-time AI rescheduling (reactive to every task add)
rejected_choices.reason: too costly in API calls and UX-disruptive — one-shot on demand is the right pattern

rejected_choices.choice: monthly token limit for AI chat
rejected_choices.reason: unpredictable UX — per-plan token limit is more intuitive and aligned to actual usage unit
static prevents CSS custom properties from being emitted to :root — breaks all var(--color-*) usage outside utility classes

rejected_choices.choice: duplicating html/body/reset rules in each app globals.css
rejected_choices.reason: three identical CSS blocks will drift over time — all shared base rules belong in packages/ui/styles/base.css
Clerk is useless on a marketing site and adds unnecessary JS weight and auth context overhead to a static site

rejected_choices.choice: Clerk env vars in the monorepo root .env
rejected_choices.reason: root .env leaks auth secrets to apps that do not need them — env vars must be scoped to apps/workspace/.env.local
TypeScript cannot resolve fetch, Response, or any browser global without lib:dom — causes 'Cannot find name fetch' errors on every fetch() call

rejected_choices.choice: React bundled inside a shared package instead of peerDependency
rejected_choices.reason: causes version conflicts and prevents TypeScript from resolving 'react' in the package — React must always be a peer dep

known_pitfalls.bad_example: storing only recipeId on WorkTask and fetching the live recipe at display time

known_pitfalls.problem: AI token cost overrun on START plan

known_pitfalls.avoid_by: check aiTokensUsed against plan limit before every AI chat call, return 402 with upgrade prompt if over limit

known_pitfalls.bad_example: @theme static { --color-primary: oklch(0.68 0.18 22); } — var(--color-primary) is undefined at runtime
known_pitfalls.avoid_by: always use @theme {} without 'static' — static generates utilities with hardcoded values but never emits vars to :root

known_pitfalls.problem: Tailwind v4 does not auto-scan workspace packages in monorepo
known_pitfalls.bad_example: button.tsx in packages/ui uses bg-primary but the class is never generated because Tailwind only scans apps/X/src/
known_pitfalls.avoid_by: add @source '../../../../packages/ui/src' in every app's globals.css — path is relative to the CSS file, 4 levels up to monorepo root

known_pitfalls.problem: button { background: none } reset overrides utility classes when unlayered
known_pitfalls.bad_example: button { background: none } in globals.css as an unlayered rule — beats bg-primary from @layer utilities
known_pitfalls.avoid_by: all reset rules must live in packages/ui/styles/base.css inside @layer base so utilities always win

known_pitfalls.bad_example: importing @qoovex/db in apps/workspace without adding it to transpilePackages — TS error: Cannot find module '@qoovex/db'
known_pitfalls.avoid_by: every @qoovex/* TypeScript package imported by an app must be listed in transpilePackages in that app's next.config.ts

known_pitfalls.problem: duplicating html/body/reset CSS in app globals.css
known_pitfalls.bad_example: each app globals.css has identical body { font-family: var(--font-body); background-color: var(--color-bg) } blocks
known_pitfalls.avoid_by: all shared base rules live in packages/ui/styles/base.css — app globals.css only has imports + @source + app-specific rules

known_pitfalls.bad_example: pnpm --filter @qoovex/web add @clerk/nextjs and wrapping the marketing layout in ClerkProvider
known_pitfalls.avoid_by: Clerk must only be installed in apps/workspace via pnpm --filter @qoovex/workspace add @clerk/nextjs

known_pitfalls.problem: Clerk env vars in the wrong location
known_pitfalls.bad_example: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY in the monorepo root .env or in apps/web/.env.local
known_pitfalls.avoid_by: Clerk env vars belong only in apps/workspace/.env.local and in the Vercel project Qoovex-workspace environment settings

known_pitfalls.bad_example: packages/utils/tsconfig.json without lib:[dom] — causes 'Cannot find name fetch' on every fetch() call in hooks
known_pitfalls.avoid_by: add lib:[dom, dom.iterable, esnext] and jsx:react-jsx to the tsconfig of any package that uses hooks or browser APIs

known_pitfalls.bad_example: packages/utils uses useState/useEffect but react is not in peerDependencies — TypeScript: Cannot find module 'react'
known_pitfalls.avoid_by: add react to peerDependencies and @types/react + react to devDependencies in packages/utils/package.json

known_pitfalls.bad_example: .then(r => r.json()).then(data => ...) — TS7006: Parameter 'r' implicitly has an 'any' type
known_pitfalls.avoid_by: always annotate callback parameters explicitly: .then((r: Response) => r.json()).then((data: MyType[]) => ...). Define a local type at the top of the file.
